findings.title: Return through rebuilt practice
findings.claim: Within the supplied wider recurrence, the exception in 19:60 can be read as a route out of damaged succession: accepted truth, deliberate action, soundness, and entry into the Garden rebuild the qualifying sequence.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers at 19:60:4:2, 19:60:5:2, 19:60:6:1, and 19:60:8:1 are linked in the trusted cross-run record. The wider records at 25:70, 28:67, 4:124, and 40:40 repeat the return-faith-action and entry-no-wronging relations; that contact turns the four focus words from a flat eligibility list into a materially visible movement from repair to arrival.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the condition as a rebuilt sequence: return is joined to accepted faith, faith is expressed through deliberate work made sound, and the resulting entry remains joined to protection from diminishment.
findings.containment: This remains a bounded wider resonance around the supplied focus and recurrence records. It does not turn the focus into a claim about lineage, a strict earned-versus-gifted reward contrast, or a complete surah thesis; the direct promise of Garden entry and no injustice remains recoverable. The external connection rows are nominations with Arabic surface supplied but target morphology absent.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run record provides exact focus anchors and branch refs; the connection rows corroborate a wider recurrence as retrieval nominations while their target morphology is absent, so the composite reading remains qualified.
